ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and determine the extent of the issue.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to identify potential perpetrators and determine how they were able to commit fraud.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How were perpetrators able to commit fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable.
